commands.purpose: Paired complete-path CPU benchmark executing 227,385 query evaluations across 3 repetitions and 15 methods
Comprehensive accounting unit test suite verifying W4-032 and W4-033 requirements (11/11 tests passing)
Protected files audit check verifying integrity of 214 protected files (clean)

changed_files.description: Implemented run_benchmark function, paired statistical calculations, break-even accounting, and benchmark CLI subcommand.
Added test cases test_w4_033_c01 through c07 covering thread isolation, input equivalence, warmup separation, trace schema, paired speed ratios, and break-even premises.

artifacts.description: Fine-grained per-query timing trace recording 227,385 rows across 3 repetitions, 15 methods, and 5,053 queries.
Comprehensive benchmark report containing paired comparisons vs M00/M01/M16, p50/p95, paired t-tests, and empirical break-even accounting.

requirement_evidence.evidence: Executed benchmark under strict single-thread CPU isolation (torch.set_num_threads(1)) with declared run order and logged environment profile. Verified by test_w4_033_c01_host_and_thread_isolation.

M00 core, M01 wrapper, M16 owned, and candidate methods evaluated using identical pre-allocated RAM-resident QueryView instances at batch=1, matching exact output contracts and timing scopes. Verified by test_w4_033_c02_same_ram_inputs_and_contract.

Cold-start setup and 50 warmup queries executed and reset before the operational measurement loop. Amortization horizon declared across the 5,053-query stream. Verified by test_w4_033_c03_warmup_and_cold_start_separation.

Measured complete-path query execution without omitting fallback forward execution, anchor computation, or cache state updates. No double-counting of baseline inference. Verified by test_w4_033_c04_c05_timing_trace_columns_and_timer_isolation.

Isolated timer strictly around adapter.process_query(qv) using time.perf_counter_ns(). Excluded disk CSV logging, dataframe indexing, and shadow reference validation from operational query latency. Verified by test_w4_033_c04_c05_timing_trace_columns_and_timer_isolation.

Reported per-repetition total ms, repetition std, throughput (qps), and per-query mean, p50, p95, min, max latencies. Computed speed ratios strictly as ratio of paired operational totals. Recorded honest negative scientific results: M03 incremental speed ratio 0.1775x vs M00 (net savings -463.38%), M01 wrapper 0.2040x vs M00, M05-M13 regional certifications <= 0.69x vs M00. Verified by test_w4_033_c06_c07_paired_speed_ratios_and_break_even.

Documented break-even model R* = C_check / (C_base - C_reuse) and compared theoretical premises with empirical trace realities. Incremental M03 achieves 100% hits (5,034) but tensor slicing cost (C_check + C_reuse = 1.93ms) exceeds baseline forward (0.34ms). Regional methods achieve 0% certified hits (H19) and fail-closed fallback incurs bound checking overhead. Verified by test_w4_033_c06_c07_paired_speed_ratios_and_break_even.

limitations: Single-thread CPU benchmark results are hardware-dependent and specific to SmallCNN1D K=12 on CPU. GPU or dedicated hardware accelerators may alter break-even trade-offs.
Certified regional methods (M05-M13) produce speed ratios <= 1.0 due to vanishing coverage under streaming perturbations (H19), accurately reflecting negative scientific results.
